column1: # Plans, filings, bond disclosures and tenders for computing centres in mainland China that name Nvidia chips or, for comparison, home-made ones, as each saved page says: 35 rows, made on Nov 25, 2026. state_linked_or_private gives only what the page itself shows, and "not stated" otherwise. tier is told by the site that carries the page: 1 = a government page, a company's filing or a body's own notice (16 rows); 2 = a trade or press account, sites that reprint filings and tenders included (14 rows); five rows rest on one page of each tier and are marked "1 and 2" or "2 and 1". By their own credits, the pages of two rows of tier 1 are press reports that official sites carry: the Chongqing legislature's site carries a Hualong Net report (来源：华龙网), and the Hami city portal its local news centre's account (来源：哈密零距离). reached_before says whether the project had read the page before this search. Every chip_words cell was checked against its saved copy by script. A plan or a tender is not a purchase, a delivery or an import; two rows on Qingyang are statements of what was installed, in China Telecom's and a builder's own words. Not a census: the plans two searches found whose pages could be saved.
